Cutiefly

Bug Fairy

Alola · Generation 7

Cutiefly is a Bug/Fairy-type Bee Fly Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.1 m tall and weighs 0.2 kg. It evolves into Ribombee. Its highest base stat is Speed (84), with a base stat total of 304.
